Cosmo First Limited.note: Formerly known as Cosmo Films Limited, the company renamed itself to Cosmo First Limited in 2022.

Film Tech, LLC.note: Film Tech LLC was acquired by Soteria Flexibles in 2019.

Plantic Technologies Ltd..note: Kuraray successfully completed the acquisition of all shares in Plantic Technologies Limited in April 2015.

SABIC Innovative Plastics.note: Saudi Basic Industries Corporation completed the acquisition of GE Plastics in 2007 and renamed it SABIC Innovative Plastics, which was later reorganized.

Shriram PolyTech Ltd.note: Teknor Apex acquired a 50% stake in Shriram PolyTech Limited from DCM Shriram Limited.

TSRC Corporation.note: TSRC Corporation is a publicly traded company on the Taiwan Stock Exchange and has not been acquired; it remains independently operating.

Vikram Thermo Ltd..note: Vikram Thermo Ltd. is a publicly listed independent company primarily owned by its promoter family (the Patel family).

Braskem S.A..note: Braskem S.A. remains an independent company, though its majority shareholder Novonor agreed to sell a controlling stake to affiliates of IG4 Capital in 2026.

Green PVC Joint Stock Company.note: Green PVC Joint Stock Company operates as an independent manufacturer of PVC compounds in Vietnam.

Mitsubishi Engineering-Plastics Corporat.note: Mitsubishi Gas Chemical Company acquired an additional 25% stake in 2023, making Mitsubishi Engineering-Plastics Corporation a 75%-owned consolidated subsidiary.

Sparsh Polychem Private Limited.note: Sparsh Polychem Private Limited operates as an independent, privately owned engineering plastic compounds manufacturer in India.
